toolchain.description: Ruby 3.1-3.3 with Bundler (mise.toml pins 3.3.12); a focused ActionView/ActionPack component runtime pinned to versions from Rails' own Gemfile.lock at this commit.
toolchain.agentNotes:
This is a focused component runtime for ActionView, ActionPack, ActiveModel, and ActiveSupport tests, not Rails' complete development Gemfile. Gems are preinstalled and frozen; do not install others. Run a test file or a script from the checkout root with the checkout's load paths:

```sh
bundle exec ruby -Iactivesupport/lib -Iactionview/lib -Iactionpack/lib -Iactivemodel/lib -Iactionview/test -Iactionpack/test <test-or-script.rb>
```

BUNDLE_GEMFILE, BUNDLE_PATH, and BUNDLE_FROZEN are already set in the environment.
